summary: Configured and verified Redis Sentinel HA with TLS/authentication. node1 is primary; node2 and node3 are synchronized replicas. The proof key is ready, credentials are at /root/redis-admin.env on node1, and the CA is installed at /etc/redis/pki/ca.crt.
actions_performed: Enabled TLS-only authenticated Redis on 6379 and Sentinel on 26379
Generated shared CA and node-identity certificates
Configured Sentinel quorum 2 and automatic failover
Enabled AOF persistence and boot-start services
Verified cross-node TLS, replication, discovery, quorum, and AOF health
Did not reboot nodes or inject failures
